answer.text: Done as your 2026-10-31 update asks, merged into sylva's main: .github/workflows/ (ci.yml, deny.yml) removed, and what only CI ran is now declared checks (proposal 01a1ed13-d166, accepted). Every commit: clippy and tests with all features, tests and clippy without std. Before a push: clippy and tests with default features; wasm32 builds without std, plain and with serde. Before a release: clippy with each feature alone (serde, log, sign, sqlite, crypt, knowledge, ts), cargo deny (advisories, bans, sources), and a blocking release gate that every test passes. The per-feature check caught a real bug on its first run (crypt alone left two sqlite-only imports unused; fixed in fb7a148). deny.toml's header now says it runs before a release. The baseline render that took out deny.yml was taken too.
